label: Classic Basic
description: Fast old-school play with descending armor class, class tables, simple saves, and lightweight character options.

label: Advanced Classic 1e
description: A stricter classic framework with table-driven combat, granular saves, and more detailed class structure.

label: Advanced Classic 2e
description: A refined classic framework with THAC0-style attacks, class advancement, and broader character customization.

label: Modern 3e
description: A detailed d20 framework with ascending armor class, attack bonuses, Fortitude/Reflex/Will saves, skill ranks, feats, and more granular character customization.

label: Modern 5e
description: A familiar modern fantasy rules framework with ascending armor class, proficiency-based advancement, ability checks, saving throws, and standardized d20 combat.
